question: Under the European Democracy Shield, the Commission announced a new media resilience programme to support independent journalism and media literacy and strengthen the sustainability of the news media sector, including local journalism. However, it remains unclear how and when local and regional media organisations in Ireland will be able to access the additional support envisaged under the new programme. Can the Commission clarify: 1.
What is the timetable for the implementation of the media resilience programme and when will the first relevant funding opportunities become available?
Will Irish local and regional newspapers be directly eligible for funding?
What funding does the Commission envisage making available in 2026 and 2027, and through which specific EU programmes or calls will eligible Irish media organisations be able to apply?
